content.title: It's Tax Day. Here's where you can get a break on your next meal
content.text: Updated April 15, 2026, 1:12 p.m. ETTax breaks are great, but what about a break on your lunch or coffee today?It's Tax Day, and several restaurants have deals to help you afford to eat out. Here's a look at some of this year's options.BJ's Restaurant & BrewhouseOn April 15, customers can get $10 off any purchase of $40 or more.Buca di BeppoThrough April 19, Buca di Beppo customers who buy one pasta can get one for free. The offer applies to dine-in, carryout, and delivery orders placed at dineatbuca.com. Ask for “TAXPASTABOGO” when ordering in the restaurant or enter it as the promo code at checkout when ordering online.Checkers & Rally’sOn April 14 and April 15, Checkers & Rally’s restaurants will serve the Big Buford hamburger for $3.Dickey's BarbecueDickey's Barbecue is offering customers $10 off orders of $50 or more using code "WRITEOFF." The deal is available exclusively online and on the Dickey's app on April 14 and 15.Fazoli'sThe chain is offering rewards members a BOGO baked spaghetti deal at participating locations on April 15.Great American Cookies Rewards members can get a BOGO deal on chocolate chip cookie cake slices on April 15 at participating locations. The offer is valid only for in-store purchases.Grimaldi's PizzaGrimaldi's Pizza is offering $10.40 off any purchase of $40 or more all day on April 15. The offer is available for dine-in, to-go and online orders using code "TAXDAY26."HootersOn April 15, dine-in customers can order $4.15 Burgers with a side, $2.50 American Drafts and free Kids’ Meals.The burgers come with a choice of baked beans or coleslaw.One free Kids’ Meal comes with the purchase of an adult entree. Kids' Meals choices include Wings, Hamburger, Grilled Cheese or Boneless Wings, all served with fries. The offer is valid for guests 12 and younger.Order food with DoorDashKona IceKona Ice trucks will give free Shaved Ice on April 15. Find a location at www.kona-ice.com.Krispy KremeOn April 15, Krispy Kreme customers who purchase any dozen doughnuts at regular price can get a second Original Glazed dozen for free.The offer applies to purchases made in-shop and through the drive-thru as well as orders for pick-up or delivery through the Krispy Kreme app.Order food with Uber EatsParis BaguetteParis Baguette is offering PB Rewards members a free pastry with any beverage purchase on April 15.Penn Station East Coast SubsOn April 15, Penn Station customers can get any small sub for $5.99 using code "TAX26," limit five per order.Pizza HutOn April 15, Pizza Hut customers can get a large three-topping pizza starting at $10 on their choice of one of three crusts – Hand Tossed, Tavern Style or Thin 'N Crispy.The offer is available in-store, online or via the Pizza Hut app.PopeyesOn April 15, customers ordering on the Popeyes app or through Popeyes.com cand get a 25% off Tax Day three-piece tenders combo. The meal includes a three-piece tenders, one regular side, one biscuit and a drink.Portillo'sThrough April 15, Portillo's Perks members can get any slice of cake for $1 with a purchase of $5 or more.PotbellyPotbelly is providing a Buy One, Get One Free promotion on April 15.Customers can get a free Original size sandwich or wrap with the purchase of any Big or Original size sandwich or wrap.Access this promotion through the Potbelly app or on potbelly.com by using the promo code “BOGO” at checkout.QdobaQdoba, which gives its customers free guac, will give Rewards Members $5 off a full-sized entree for taking a short survey about a time they had to pay extra for quac someplace else.The survey must be completed by 11:59 p.m. Eastern time on April 15. The $5 off offer will be loaded on the customer’s Rewards Wallet on April 20, and will be good through April 26.Smoothie KingOn April 15, Smoothie King is offering customers $3 off when they join their Healthy Rewards loyalty program by downloading the Smoothie King app.Sonny's BBQSonny's BBQ is offering customers a $10.99 St. Louis Rib Dinner on April 15. The offer is available all day for dine-in, takeout, drive-thru and online orderingTaco John’sRewards members can get a free small Potato Olés with any April 15 purchase of at least $3, redeemable through the Taco John’s app or online ordering. Travelin' Tom's CoffeeTravelin’ Tom's trucks will give away Free Frozen Beverages of the customer's choice. The company has trucks in Louisville, Elizabethtown and Clark County.White CastleThrough April 17, customers can get 15% off their order using code "WC15OFF." Ziggi’s CoffeeZiggi’s Coffee is giving every guest a $2 Bounce Back coupon on April 15 with any in-store purchase. No sign-ups, app or extra steps are required.The offer is valid April 16-22.Contact reporter Cheryl V. Jackson at cheryl.jackson@indystar.com or 317-444-6264. Follow her on X.com:@cherylvjackson or Bluesky:@cherylvjackson.bsky.social.(This story has been updated to add additional deals.)
